question.problem: Elvis is making a peanut butter, jelly, and bacon sandwich. How many ways can he layer the sandwich filling, besides the order "bacon, then jelly, then peanut butter"?
question.worked_solution:
There are $3$ fillings to arrange, so there are $3!$ ways of arranging them:

$$
\begin{aligned}3! & =3\times 2\times 1 \\  & =6\end{aligned}
$$

The order "bacon, then jelly, then peanut butter" is one of them. By subtracting $1$ from $6,$ we find the number of the filling arrangements that can be formed beside "bacon, then jelly, then peanut butter".

$$
\begin{aligned}6-1=5\end{aligned}
$$
